f.title: Retain essential records securely for the required period and make them available
f.statement: Essential records should be retained securely by sponsors and investigators for the required period in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and be available to regulatory authorities, monitors, auditors and IRBs/IECs/HRECs on request.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: Essential records should be retained securely by sponsors and investigators for the required period in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. These essential records should be available to regulatory authorities, monitors, auditors and IRBs/IECs/HREC (as appropriate) upon request to enable appropriate evaluation of the trial conduct in order to ensure the reliability of trial results.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Investigator reports SUSARs and new safety information to the IRB/IEC/HREC promptly
f.statement: The investigator/institution should promptly report to the IRB/IEC/HREC deviations to eliminate immediate hazards to participants, changes increasing participant risk, all SUSARs in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, and new information that may adversely affect participant safety or trial conduct.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: Specifying that the investigator/institution should promptly report to the IRB/IEC/HREC (see section 1.1): (a) Deviations from the protocol to eliminate immediate hazards to the trial participants (see sections 1.4.7, 2.5.4 and 2.5.5); (b) Changes increasing the risk to participants and/or significantly affecting the conduct of the trial (see section 2.4.6); (c) All suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs) in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements; (d) New information that may adversely affect the safety of the participants or the conduct of the trial.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Provide medical care for trial-related adverse events
f.statement: During and after participation, the investigator/institution should ensure adequate medical care is provided for any trial-related adverse events, including clinically significant laboratory values, and inform participants when medical care is needed for intercurrent illnesses the investigator becomes aware of.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: During and following participation in a trial, the investigator/institution should ensure that adequate medical care is provided to a participant for any adverse events, including clinically significant laboratory values, related to the trial. The investigator/institution should inform a participant when medical care is needed for intercurrent illness(es) of which the investigator becomes aware.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Investigator reports protocol-required AEs to the sponsor within protocol timelines
f.statement: Adverse events and/or abnormal test results required for safety evaluations (as outlined in the protocol) should be reported to the sponsor within the protocol time periods; unfavourable medical events before investigational product administration (e.g. screening) should be considered and reported if the protocol requires.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Adverse events and/or abnormal test results required for safety evaluations (as outlined in the protocol) should be reported to the sponsor according to the reporting requirements and within the time periods specified in the protocol. Unfavourable medical events occurring in participants before investigational product administration (e.g., during screening) should be considered and reported to the sponsor if required by the protocol.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Investigator reports all SAEs to the sponsor immediately with causality assessment
f.statement: All SAEs should be reported to the sponsor immediately after the investigator reasonably becomes aware of them, with an assessment of causality; the protocol may identify SAEs (e.g. endpoint events) not requiring immediate reporting. Subsequent information should be submitted as follow-up reports.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.exceptions: SAEs identified in the protocol as not requiring immediate reporting (e.g. endpoint deaths)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: All serious adverse events (SAEs) should be reported immediately (after the investigator reasonably becomes aware of the event) to the sponsor. The investigator should also include an assessment of causality. In accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, the protocol may identify SAEs not requiring immediate reporting; for example, deaths or other events that are endpoints. Subsequent information should be submitted as a follow-up report, as necessary.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Supply autopsy and terminal medical reports for deaths
f.statement: For reported deaths, the investigator should supply the sponsor, the IRB/IEC and, where applicable, the Agency with any additional requested information (e.g. autopsy reports and terminal medical reports) when available.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: For reported deaths, the investigator should supply the sponsor, the IRB/IEC and, where applicable, the Agency with any additional requested information (e.g., autopsy reports and terminal medical reports) when they become available.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Investigator keeps overall responsibility for safety reporting when delegating
f.statement: The investigator may delegate safety reporting activities to qualified site staff but retains overall responsibility for participant safety and compliance with reporting requirements.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The investigator may delegate activities for safety reporting to qualified investigator site staff but retains the overall responsibility for safety of participants under their responsibility and compliance with the reporting requirements.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Be able to unblind in emergencies and document any premature unblinding
f.statement: The investigator should break the randomisation code only per protocol, be able from the start to unblind without undue delay in an emergency to protect participant safety, and promptly document and explain to the sponsor any premature unblinding (e.g. accidental, emergency, or due to an SAE).
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: In the case of an emergency, to protect participant safety, the investigator should be prepared and capable from the start of the trial to perform unblinding without undue delay and hindrance. The investigator should promptly document and explain to the sponsor any premature unblinding (e.g., accidental unblinding, emergency unblinding to protect trial participant, unblinding due to an SAE) of the investigational product(s).
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Investigator retains essential records for the required period and prevents premature destruction
f.statement: The investigator/institution should retain essential records for the required retention period or until the sponsor says they are no longer needed, whichever is longest, ensuring availability, accessibility and readability and preventing unauthorised access and premature destruction; and keep the sponsor informed of who maintains them.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: The investigator/institution should retain the essential records for the required retention period in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements or until the sponsor informs the investigator/institution that these records are no longer needed, whichever is the longest. The investigator/institution should take measures to ensure availability, accessibility and readability and to prevent unauthorised access and accidental or premature destruction of these records (see Appendix C).
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Agreements must bind investigators and service providers to record retention
f.statement: The sponsor should obtain the investigator's/institution's and service providers' agreement to comply with data recording/reporting procedures and to retain essential records for the required period or until told they are no longer needed, whichever is longest.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: To retain the essential records for the required retention period in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements or until the sponsor informs the investigator/institution or, where applicable, the service provider that these records are no longer needed, whichever is longest;

f.title: Sponsor may establish an IDMC; committees need charters and managed conflicts
f.statement: The sponsor may establish an independent data monitoring committee (IDMC) to assess trial progress, safety data and efficacy endpoints at intervals and recommend whether to continue, modify or stop. Committees that could affect participant safety should have relevant expertise, managed conflicts of interest and written procedures (e.g. charters).
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The sponsor may consider establishing an IDMC to assess the progress of a clinical trial, including the safety data and the efficacy endpoints, at intervals and to recommend to the sponsor whether to continue, modify or stop a trial.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Monitors verify adverse events are reported within required timelines
f.statement: Monitoring should include determining whether adverse events are appropriately reported within the time periods required by the protocol, GCP and regulatory requirements, and confirming the investigator maintains essential records and the arrangements for their retention.
f.clause: 3.11.4.5.2 Investigator Site Selection, Initiation, Management and Close-out (e)
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Determining whether adverse events are appropriately reported within the time periods required by the protocol, GCP and the applicable regulatory requirement(s).

f.title: Sponsor is responsible for ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product
f.statement: The sponsor is responsible for the ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product; the Investigator's Brochure (or current scientific information such as basic product information) is the basis of safety assessment and reporting.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The sponsor is responsible for the ongoing safety evaluation of the investigational product(s). The Investigator’s Brochure or, where applicable, the current scientific information such as a basic product information brochure, forms the basis of safety assessment and reporting for the clinical trial.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Aggregate and review safety information in a timely manner, including pre-dose events
f.statement: The sponsor should aggregate, as appropriate, and review relevant safety information in a timely manner, including unfavourable medical events occurring before investigational product administration (e.g. during screening); this may lead to updates of the protocol, Investigator's Brochure, informed consent materials and related documents.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The sponsor should aggregate, as appropriate, and review in a timely manner relevant safety information. This includes the review of any reported unfavourable medical events occurring in participants before investigational product administration (e.g., during screening). This may result in the update of the protocol, Investigator’s Brochure, informed consent materials and related documents.

f.title: Submit safety updates and periodic reports, including IB changes, to NAFDAC
f.statement: The sponsor should submit to the Agency safety updates and periodic reports, including changes to the Investigator's Brochure, as required by applicable regulatory requirements.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The sponsor should submit to the Agency safety updates and periodic reports, including changes to the Investigator’s Brochure, as required by applicable regulatory requirements.

f.title: Expedite reporting of SUSARs to NAFDAC per ICH E2A
f.statement: The sponsor should expedite the reporting to the Agency of all suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs) in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and ICH E2A.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The sponsor should, in accordance with the applicable regulatory requirement(s) and with ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management: Definitions and Standards for Expedited Reporting, expedite the reporting to the Agency (ies) of all suspected, unexpected and serious adverse reactions (i.e., SUSARs).

f.title: Assess expectedness against the reference safety information
f.statement: Safety reporting to regulatory authorities should assess expectedness of the reaction against the applicable product information (e.g. the reference safety information in the Investigator's Brochure or alternative documents).
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: Safety reporting to regulatory authorities should be undertaken by assessing the expectedness of the reaction in relation to the applicable product information (e.g., the reference safety information (RSI) contained within the Investigator’s Brochure or alternative documents) in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

f.title: Report SUSARs to investigators and IRBs according to urgency
f.statement: Reporting of SUSARs to investigators/institutions and IRBs/IECs/HRECs should reflect the urgency of action required and the evolving safety profile, per applicable requirements; periodic line listings with an overall safety assessment may be appropriate in some regions.
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Nigeria under the NAFDAC Good Clinical Practice Guidelines 2025 (DER-GDL-020-03, adapted from ICH E6(R3))

rows.quote: The reporting of SUSARs to investigator(s)/institutions(s) and to the IRB(s)/IEC/HREC(s) should be undertaken in a manner that reflects the urgency of action required and should take into consideration the evolving knowledge of the safety profile of the product and should be performed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement, actor and level checked against the source; no change. Double-check: quote verbatim; level follows the source modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.

f.title: Report urgent safety issues without undue delay
f.statement: Urgent safety issues requiring immediate attention or action should be reported to the IRB/IEC/HREC and/or the Agency and investigators without undue delay.

f.title: Agree alternative safety reporting arrangements prospectively with NAFDAC and describe in protocol
f.statement: Alternative arrangements for safety reporting (e.g. SAEs that are efficacy or safety endpoints not subject to unblinding and expedited reporting) should be prospectively agreed with the Agency and, if applicable, the IRB/IEC/HREC, and described in the protocol.

f.title: Act promptly on immediate hazards to participants

f.title: Manage essential records: locate, file timely, keep complete, readable and traceable
